features: 180 Degree Views Inc St Pauls, The Shard etc
Underfloor Heating Included in the Service Charge
Great Transport Links Including Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Spacious three-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment situated on the 36th floor with breathtaking 180-degree views. Type 2A.
Full-height windows and sliding glass doors lead onto a west-facing balcony with spectacular views across London, including St Paul's Cathedral, The Shard and other iconic landmarks. Each principal room has direct access to a balcony, making the most of the exceptional outlook.
The apartment offers generous storage throughout, predominantly original, including an entrance cupboard ideal for coats and additional storage. There is a family bathroom and a separate shower room with W.C.
Underfloor heating throughout is included within the service charge. Three lifts. Twenty-four-hour concierge. Residents enjoy access to the beautifully maintained Barbican gardens. Parking is available by separate negotiation with the City of London.
Please note that, under the terms of the head lease, pets are not permitted.
Designed by the renowned architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon, the Barbican Estate is home to the Barbican Arts Centre, cinema, art gallery, concert hall, restaurants, bars and cafés. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are all close by.
Perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon (offering direct services to Heathrow and Gatwick) and Liverpool Street stations within a short walk. Barbican, St Paul's and Moorgate Underground stations are also nearby, providing excellent transport links across London.
Service Charge: Estimated £11,866 plus £624 for non-annually recurring items, for 2026/2027,
Lease: Extended to 2197.
Ground Rent: Peppercorn.
